finding: A TFChain object was previously counted as cached-history availability even when no source observations could populate that timeframe. This allowed an invalid parity/research replay to run against a 20m-only source while the strategy requested lower timeframes.

verified_runtime_readiness.reason: 20m observations can build 60m/240m/daily chains but cannot causally synthesize 15m or 30m bars.

invalid_pre_repair_diagnostic.reason: Generated while required 5m/15m source coverage was absent; retained only as proof of the repaired false-availability path.

multi_level_csv_scan.misleading_filename_note: CME_MINI_DL_NQ1!, 5.csv in the different-chart-types archive has modal spacing 1200 seconds, so it is not a 5-minute clock series.

repair.rule: Raw observations can build requested TF m only when sub_minutes <= m and m % sub_minutes == 0, with scored-window coverage checks. Chain allocation alone is never availability evidence.
